title: T.N. Assembly election: discrepancies surface in affidavits filed by Vijay for Tiruchi East and Perambur
summary: These are with respect to personal details, criminal disclosures, and asset declarations. The Tiruchi East affidavit includes details of movable assets of his wife, son, and daughter, that don’t figure in the Perambur one

title: TVK chief Vijay files revised set of nominations in Perambur, Tiruchi East correcting discrepancies
summary: In the revised set of nominations, Mr. Vijay has declared two cases pending against him — one at the Peravallur police station for allegedly violating election norms in the Kolathur Assembly seat, where he campaigned on March 30 after filing his nominations

title: Pakistan jibes become central to BJP’s Assam poll narrative
summary: Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma has been attacking Congress leader Gaurav Gogoi over his alleged Pakistan connections, his latest barb was aimed at the mother of a candidate whom he accused of sympathising with ‘anti-national’ elements

title: Assembly elections LIVE: BJP releases 5th list for Bengal polls; veteran, ex-Union minister’s kin get tickets
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is set to launch the BJP’s campaign for West Bengal Assembly elections from Cooch Behar today

title: Election Commission suspends four police officers over lapses at Suvendu Adhikari roadshow in Bhabanipur
summary: Disciplinary action initiated against four officers; EC asks their positions to be filled by replacements immediately

title: Kerala Assembly polls: LDF’s manifesto vows to eradicate absolute poverty, hike welfare pensions to ₹3,000
summary: Ruling front’s manifesto outlines a 60-point programme containing 950 proposals to create a ‘Nava Kerala’ (New Kerala), while seeking a mandate to continue ongoing development works

title: Distress among potato farmers emerges as poll issue in West Bengal
summary: Three farmer deaths linked to falling prices; Opposition, ruling party trade charges

title: Madhya Pradesh lodge collapse death toll rises to two; NDRF continues rescue ops
summary: ‘Aggarwal Lodge', a building located near a bus stand in Kotma town, collapsed around 5.30 p.m. on Saturday (April 4, 2026), trapping several people in the vicinity
